identification: Three boxes of giant-scale RC aircraft petrol engines and parts. Box 1: a ZDZ (Polish) opposed twin (boxer, lying on its side: one cylinder with black ZDZ-marked head, the other cylinder silver-finned, possibly a mismatched/replacement head), twin ignition leads to two plug caps, prop hub, carb with braided fuel line; size not readable (old-style ZDZ boxer, likely 80-120cc class). Same box: a second, part-dismantled single-cylinder petrol engine (crankcase with Walbro-type carb and long prop shaft with copper/bronze collar, its piston, and a loose black finned ZDZ-style head lying separately), Graupner nylon prop packets (blue 'Nylon-Luftschraube'), Menz-style wooden props, carbon/black props, a 'Classic Series' prop packet, prop spacers. Box 2: a large single-cylinder petrol engine with silver head, side exhaust, rear carb, standoff mount with long bolts, a circular maker's logo on the crankcase and a 'Made in Germany'-type foil label (looks like a 3W, unconfirmed), CDI electronic ignition box (label reads 'CDI Electronic Ignition', maker partly readable, probably Rcexl), ignition leads in spiral wrap, a pair of canister/tuned mufflers (twin outlets), silicone pipes. Box 3: glow engines and parts: one 4-stroke-looking glow engine with chrome rocker covers (possibly a twin), a 2-stroke glow engine head and carb, several aluminium mufflers (one stamped S.C.M.?), engine mounts, and a loose yellow 'DLE-30' banner sticker (no DLE engine visible).

viewing_check: Read the ZDZ twin's crankcase/cylinder for capacity (80/100/120 B2) and turn it over for compression on both cylinders; check whether the silver cylinder is a ZDZ part; check the ignition module is present for the twin. On the big silver single, read the crankcase logo and label (3W? Sachs/Dolmar?) and the cc, turn it over; read the CDI box maker. Count what's in the glow box and read the makes (OS, Saito, Enya, Super Tigre) on the crankcases, especially the one with chrome rocker covers (a twin 4-stroke would be worth more). Check the dismantled engine has its cylinder.
